Explore x1 armed: the next 8 page loads of the page the first one loads (later loads of other pages and tabs are left alone) get these delivery schedules, in order:
  1. baseline 1 (responses in request order)
  2. baseline 2 (responses in request order)
  3. seed 1
  4. seed 2
  5. seed 3
  6. seed 4
  7. seed 5
  8. seed 6

Now run the same scenario 8 times, one page load each (reload or navigate fresh every time): load the page, do the user steps, then wait for `await page.evaluate(() => window.__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000))`.
With Playwright: `npx playwright test <spec> --repeat-each 8 --workers 1`. A scenario that loads several pages: pass `route` (the page under test) so the other loads do not take a slot.
Then: genclass_explore {action:"report", id:"x1"}.
